title: 第15章 那么大一个哨兵掏出个粉色手帕-《同时被N个S级哨兵盯上怎么办》
content:
第(1/3)页

    秦夙哭声实在很嘹亮，也很有感染力。

    魏知弦微蹙眉心，嘴唇抿成了一条线，也像是感同身受了一样，有些伤感。

    “想哭就痛快的哭一会儿。”他轻轻搂过秦夙肩膀，弯下腰来把她抱入怀里，“这次通讯很顺利，你没有犯错，按规定，每个月都可以申请一次，下次申请应该还能批下来的，所以下个月，就又能跟爷爷说话了。”

    秦夙都哭的瑟瑟发抖，“可……我还要等一个月，一个月啊！”

    魏知弦没法再强调冷酷的白塔规定。

    他只有一遍遍去轻抚她的后背，低声重复，“很快的，一个月很快就会过去了。”

    秦夙痛痛快快在魏知弦怀抱中哭了一场。

    哭的时间，比打电话的时间还要长。

    其间，秦夙只顾着发泄情绪，魏知弦也保持着沉默。

    只是用他的大手，一遍遍在秦夙背后轻轻拍抚。

    还有黑豹，用脑袋轻轻拱在秦夙脚旁。

    等冷静下来之后，秦夙不好意思的推推魏知弦，“对……对不起，把你衣服弄湿了一大片。”

    “没事。”魏知弦换军礼服本来就是为了强调身份，好方便带秦夙打这通电话用的，“一会儿换下来，让人去洗就是。”

    “那，你……你能放开我吗？”

    怎么她推他，他还抱着不放呢？

    魏知弦这才回过神似的，慢慢松开手。

    然后从笔挺的衣服口袋里取出张折叠整齐的手帕，交到了秦夙手里。

    这帕子，颜色怎么粉粉的？而且上面还绣着朵小花？

    真是魏知弦的帕子吗？

    秦夙对着看了一会儿，“噗”的一下就乐了，“你……你这个……”

    魏知弦见她笑了，缓缓吐出口气，“是托卢娜帮忙去领的，我也没想到她会选这种颜色和花样。你留着用吧。”

    秦夙把手帕糊到脸上胡乱擦一擦，“跟你一样，都有消毒水的味道。”
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Qin Su’s cry was really loud and contagious.

Wei Zhixian frowned slightly and pursed his lips into a line, as if he felt the same thing, a little sad.

"If you want to cry, just cry happily." He gently put his arm around Qin Su's shoulders and bent down to hold her in his arms. "This communication went very smoothly. You made no mistake. According to the regulations, you can apply once a month. The next application should be approved, so next month, I can talk to grandpa again."

Qin Su was crying and trembling, "But... I have to wait for another month, one month!"

Wei Zhixian can no longer emphasize the cold rules of the White Tower.

He could only caress her back over and over again, repeating in a low voice, "Soon, a month will pass soon."

Qin Su cried happily in Wei Zhixian's arms.

The time spent crying was longer than the time spent on the phone.

During this period, Qin Su only focused on venting his emotions, while Wei Zhixian also remained silent.

He just used his big hands to gently pat Qin Su's back over and over again.

There was also a black panther, who gently placed his head next to Qin Su's feet.

After calming down, Qin Su pushed Wei Zhixian embarrassingly, "Yes...I'm sorry, your clothes got wet all over."

"It's okay." Wei Zhixian changed into a military uniform to emphasize his status and make it easier for him to take Qin Su to make this call. "Just change it out in a while and let someone wash it."

"Then, you...can you let me go?"

Why did he still hold her while she pushed him?

Wei Zhixian seemed to have come to his senses and slowly let go of his hand.

Then he took out a neatly folded handkerchief from his straight pocket and handed it to Qin Su.

Why is this handkerchief so pink in color?And there's a little flower embroidered on it?

Is it really Wei Zhixian’s veil?

Qin Su looked at each other for a while, and suddenly became happy, "You... you..."

Seeing her smile, Wei Zhixian slowly exhaled, "Toluna helped to pick it up. I didn't expect her to choose this color and pattern. You can keep it for use."

Qin Su put a handkerchief on his face and wiped it randomly, "It smells like disinfectant just like you."
